shorts.hook: This giant caiman ruled the rivers of ancient Brazil.
shorts.title: This Ancient Caiman Weighed More Than Five Hippos
shorts.outro: Then the river started to bulge. Doug went back in for the badge. Full video below.
shorts.description: Purussaurus, a giant caiman from ancient Brazil, may have weighed over eight tonnes and bitten with seven tonnes of force; see what the river did next in the full episode.

shorts.title: Titanoboa Was Longer Than a City Bus
shorts.outro: Doug survived the biggest snake ever. Next stop: the last grass on Earth, and something five hippos heavy. Linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT FOUND THE HIPPO'S LAST GRASS?
shorts.description: Titanoboa stretched about thirteen meters and needed a world hotter than any heatwave; the full episode reveals what found the hippo's last grass.

shorts.hook: Doug took a hippo back 150 million years.
shorts.title: These Dinosaur Footprints Were a Meter Long
shorts.outro: The Allosaurus looked at Doug, then at the hippo, and made its choice. Which one is in the full video below.
shorts.description: In the grassless Jurassic, a hippo's perfect pool turns out to be a sauropod footprint a meter long; find out who the Allosaurus picked in the full episode.
